description:
This position is responsible for the system level design of the ACS (Air-Conditioning Service) products. This will include the high level design documentation for electro-mechanical systems and components, including interactions between the software, hardware, and mechanical components, such as motors, sensors, switches, and controls.  The candidate will work closely with a cross functional team to deliver products on-time, on-spec, and on-budget.  To be successful, the candidate must be innovative, creative, detail oriented, comfortable working from a vision, and comfortable working in a fast-pace environment while handling multiple projects simultaneously
  
 PRINCIPLE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES (ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS) 
 Conceptualize and document system level architecture design of the AC service products.
 Create system level design documentation.
 Coordinate testing and documentation required to achieve and maintain product certifications (UL, CE, etc.)
 Create test plans and reports to validate design concepts.
 Troubleshoot problems to assist with manufacturing or reduce warranty costs.
 Team leadership - lead the project team to be creative, accurate, detailed, and professional.
 Perform design analysis and FMEA‘s on system designs to assure form, fit, function, and safety.
 Maintain project documentation, i.e. design reviews, FMEAs, design specifications, wiring diagrams, test plans, etc.
 Represent the Design Engineering Team with professionalism and integrity when communicating with the Customer, Cross Functional Teams and the entire organization.
 Takes full responsibility for providing the customer (internal and external) with service and products (documentation, prototypes, etc.) that exceed customer’s expectations.
 
 Four year Engineering degree, BSEE preferred
 3+ years related experience preferred.
 Proven design skills, utilizing knowledge of similar product.
 Proficiency in PC skills; Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Visio, etc), CAD experience (Solidworks) preferred, Labview preferred.
 Proven ability to work effectively in a cross functional team environment.  Experience working with global/international teams also highly desirable.
 Previous experience with product certifications (UL) preferred.
 Good oral and written communication skills with solid documentation skills
 Proven ability to handle multiple projects keeping accurate documentation and records
 Ability to work well with challenging individuals and customers
 Indefinite U.S. work authorized individuals only. Future sponsorship for work authorization not available. 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 
 Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans. 
 The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $99,900 - $116,000. Within the range, individual pay is determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, work experience and job knowledge, complexity of the role, job location, etc. 
 In addition to your base salary, Bosch offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes health, dental, and vision plans; health savings accounts (HSA); flexible spending accounts; 401(K) retirement & Bosch Defined Contribution plan with an attractive employer match; wellness programs; life insurance; short and long term disability insurance; paid time off; parental leave, adoption assistance; and reimbursement of education expenses. Learn more about our full benefits offerings by visiting:  https://www.myboschbenefits.com/public/welcome . Pay ranges included in the postings generally reflect base salary; certain positions may include bonus, commission, or additional benefits.
